newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to release next tankan survey in April.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to release next tankan survey in April.

text.p: The Bank of Japan said it would release the results of its quarterly business survey, known as the "tankan", in early April instead of in late February as it has done in the past.

The BOJ, in its announcement on Thursday, said it had altered the overall schedule of its quarterly tankan announcements to issue the reports in early April, early July, early October and mid December.
Up until now the tankans had been issued in late February, late May, late August and late November.

A BOJ official told reporters that the survey whose results will be announced in early April will be conducted around March 20, much closer to the end of the business year than in the past, when the survey had been conducted in early February.
Companies have asked the BOJ to conduct a survey much closer to the end of business year so that their business plan for the following business year is more firmly fixed, he said.
The official said the time gap between the survey date and the announcement date will be reduced to about 10 days from the current gap of about 20 days.
The BOJ also said the number of survey items will be halved to about 30 from 60 in a bid to reduce the burden of companies in filling in the survey.
The changes are aimed at boosting the accuracy of the survey and making its results easier to use, the BOJ said.
